winter_agent_v2/ocr.py:3780 selected_tab_from_live_labels accepted a stroke pair as the bracket when its centre sat within 0.03 of a tab label. The bracket is drawn centred on the tab, so the TRUE pair lands ~1 px from its own label; a frame whose strip draws more icons produces spurious 134.5 px stroke pairs whose centre happens to sit 15 px from the neighbouring 失控的雪怪 label. With two kinds matching, the function refuses to guess and returns None.

Measured over 40 archived frames whose ledger row says resource_search_open=true (720x1280): true pair -> its own label 0.0000 / 0.0003 / 0.0010 (worst 1.0 px); spurious pair -> any label 0.0212 .. 0.0799 (best 15.3 px). Separation 15.3x; the old lock sat above the best spurious distance, so it could not tell them apart.
